3) Concurrent edit to Task T's Description between read and write (I43): Block stale write immediately; re-read current live Description, preserve concurrent edits, and reconcile with user confirmation if conflicting.

4) Timeout retry finding existing Task T9 titled 'Send launch brief' (I46, I39, I01): Block blind duplicate creation and block automatic deletion. Title equality alone neither proves duplicate identity nor authorizes deletion; inspect T9 by stable ID, relations, body, and timestamps to reuse verified T9 or clarify if distinct.
